migration_plan: Governance PR146 separate from executable integration stacked on it; preserve PR132 originals and PR142 cognition. No main writes or automatic merge.

steps: Revert additive runtime commits or leave the draft unmerged.
Preserve original sources, evidence, failed probes and negative results.
Existing signed STOP and revocation remain effective.
